name: Cross-Session State Update
description: Can the system track state changes across sessions?

conversation.content: Our team has 4 developers: Alice (frontend), Bob (backend), Carol (devops), and Dave (mobile).
Got it — small focused team. What project are you working on?
An e-commerce platform. We're in the planning phase.
Update: Dave left the team last week. We hired Eve as his replacement — she's also mobile but has backend experience too.
Personnel changes happen. Eve's dual skills could be an asset.
Another update: Carol got promoted to team lead. We hired Frank for devops to backfill her old role.
Congrats to Carol! The team is growing.
Who is on my team right now, what are their roles, and who leads the team?

query: What is the current team composition?
expected: Carol (team lead), Alice (frontend), Bob (backend), Eve (mobile/backend), Frank (devops). Dave left.
